overview: Finalize the simulation loop by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing the tick-based event queue for O(1) access, and compressing colonist psychological states into bit-packed structures to reduce memory footprint by 40%.

tasks.title: Implement Deterministic State Hashing for Save/Load Integrity
tasks.architectural_spec: struct StateHash { uint64_t value; }; class StateHasher { public: static constexpr uint64_t Compute(const void* data, size_t size) noexcept; };
acceptance_criteria: Hash computation is deterministic across platforms.
Unit tests verify consistency for 1000 random states.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures reliable save/load functionality without corruption.

tasks.title: Optimize Tick-Based Event Queue with O(1) Access
tasks.architectural_spec: class EventQueue { public: void Push(Event e) noexcept; Event Pop() noexcept; private: std::array<Event, 1024> buffer; size_t head = 0; size_t tail = 0; };
acceptance_criteria: Push and Pop operations are O(1).
Handles overflow gracefully with static buffer.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Reduces simulation lag during high-event-density scenarios.

tasks.title: Bit-Packed Colonist Psychological State Compression
tasks.architectural_spec: struct ColonistState { uint8_t mood : 4; uint8_t energy : 4; uint8_t hunger : 4; uint8_t thirst : 4; }; static_assert(sizeof(ColonistState) == 2);
acceptance_criteria: State size reduced to 2 bytes per colonist.
No performance regression in state updates.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster state lookups and reduced memory usage for large colonies.
